document.title: Throne of Grace Integrated Ventures — Admin/Operations Console Overview
document.purpose: A complete, shareable description of the admin (staff operations) web app: what it is, who can use it, how it works, and everything it contains.
document.generatedFor: Sharing with someone to understand the admin page in full
document.scope: Admin/staff console (apps/admin) as implemented in the current codebase
document.note: Aligned with the current operating plan: refill orders are fulfilled by the team going to the customer's location to refill the cylinder on-site, or by station refill. No cylinder is dispatched to the customer. 'Dispatched' for an on-site refill means the team is en route.

product.name: TOGIV Operations — Admin Console
product.audience: Staff/operators (roles such as super_admin, admin, agent, delivery as configured)
product.goal: Provide a fast, clear workspace to monitor operations, triage and progress refill/service requests, review claims, view customer records, manage staff accounts (super admin), and see account/configuration status.

serviceModelAlignment.refillFulfillment: On-site refill (team travels to customer location and fills the cylinder there) or station refill (customer brings cylinder in).
serviceModelAlignment.dispatchTerminology: For on-site refills, 'Dispatched' is treated/displayed as the team being en route (not a cylinder dispatched).
serviceModelAlignment.paymentRule: Refill completion requires payment to be confirmed as paid or waived (enforced server-side); staff record/confirm payment in the request detail.
serviceModelAlignment.focus: Operations centered on receiving and handling refill orders efficiently, with supporting claims/customer/staff management.

technology.uiLibrary: Shared internal UI components (@togi/ui): Button, Card, StatusPill, Modal, Skeleton, EmptyState, ErrorState, Toasts, etc.

devServer.apiProxy: Same-origin /api proxied to the API at http://localhost:3000

technology.buildOutput: Static production build (Vite), with lazy-loaded route pages
technology.liveUpdates: Smart polling + refresh on tab focus/visibility regain (no manual reload). Loaders stay silent when data exists to avoid flashing; last-good snapshots retained on transient poll errors where applicable.

authenticationAndAccess.method: Staff sign-in with password + TOTP (two-factor authenticator code)
authenticationAndAccess.audience: Admin/staff audience with separate, audience-bound session/CSRF cookies (isolated from customer sessions).

clientSecurity.csrf: Double-submit CSRF: admin_csrf cookie echoed as x-csrf-token on mutations; client can refresh via /auth/csrf and replay on CSRF expiry
clientSecurity.errorHandling: 5xx surfaced as generic service-unavailable message; other errors surfaced from API payloads

steps: Password step: enter work email or phone + password; POST /auth/staff/login
If TOTP required: enter 6-digit authenticator code and POST /auth/staff/login again

If first login/enrollment required: server issues enrollment; client fetches setup (POST /auth/staff/enroll/setup) to show secret/otpauth URI, user adds authenticator and verifies with POST /auth/staff/enroll/verify
On success: session established, refresh /auth/staff/me, redirect to intended page (default /queue)
loginFlow.properties: Enumeration-resistant/uniformly timed behavior mirrored by UI; TOTP guesses count toward throttling/lockout (server-enforced).

authenticationAndAccess.sessionBootstrap: GET /auth/staff/me to resolve current staff user (id, phone, email, fullName, department, roles, totpEnrolled); POST /auth/logout to sign out.
authenticationAndAccess.routeProtection: All console routes except /login are behind a session gate (redirects anonymous users to /login, preserving intended destination). APIs enforce authorization/permissions server-side.

routesAndPages.name: Request queue
routesAndPages.purpose: High-throughput triage and progression of many requests at once without leaving the list.
routesAndPages.dataSource: GET /requests?status=... based on selected tab/view (polled ~8s); optimistic local updates on actions then reconciled

viewsAndFilters.search: Search by reference, name, or phone

rowDesign.density: Compact, high-density rows optimized for handling many customers quickly
shows: Compact context (On-site/Station for refills, or request type) and unpaid/payment-pending flag for refills when applicable
Age (relative time, with full timestamp on hover/title)
Current status pill with contextual label (e.g. 'Team en route' for on-site refill when dispatched)

actions.quickAdvance: One-click advances a request to the next normal step per the approved transition matrix (nextStaffStep). Reason-required moves open a confirmation modal requiring a short reason.
actions.keyboardTriage: j/k move selection, a advance selected, Enter open detail, / focus search

states: Error handling with last-good snapshot messaging when possible

routesAndPages.name: Request detail
routesAndPages.purpose: Full operator view of a single request: context, payment, status progression, attempts, and messages.

header: Type and refill option (on-site/station) with contextual meaning

payment.summary: Payment status, amount, method, and reference when present
payment.editForm: Record/confirm payment via POST /requests/:id/payment (status: unpaid/pending/paid/waived; method: cash/transfer/pos/other; amount in ₦ converted to kobo; reference; internal note)
payment.guidance: Warns when a refill is unpaid; completion is blocked until payment is Paid or Waived

displays.progress: Status history timeline (collapsed by default to the latest update with 'Show all N updates' / 'Show latest only' toggle), showing from→to, notes, time, and internal/customer visibility marker
displays.serviceAttempts: Recorded service/visit attempts (attempt number, failure reason, status) when present
displays.messages: Messages with timestamps and internal markers when present

keyWorkflows.triageAndProgress: Staff monitor Overview/Queue, search/filter, and advance requests quickly (one-click/keyboard) through matrix-validated steps, adding reasons where required.
keyWorkflows.onSiteRefillHandling: For home/on-site refills, 'Dispatched' represents the team en route; staff coordinate using contact/location context and service attempts.
keyWorkflows.paymentAndCompletion: Staff record/confirm payment on the request; refill cannot be completed until payment is paid or waived.
keyWorkflows.claimsReview: Staff review pending claims with evidence/history, approve/reject with notes, and reopen rejected claims with reason when appropriate.
keyWorkflows.customerLookup: Authorized staff browse/search directory context and drill into a customer's profile, addresses, cylinders, and recent requests/claims.
keyWorkflows.staffProvisioning: Super admin creates staff accounts with role and temporary password; staff complete TOTP enrollment on first login.

dataAndLiveUpdates.behavior: Immediate load, periodic refresh while visible, refresh on focus/visibility, no overlapping requests, silent refresh when data exists.

designAndUsability.palette: Brand blue and red on dark/navy-toned surfaces consistent with the platform
designAndUsability.efficiency: Compact queue rows, quick-advance actions, keyboard triage, search/filter/sort, and live polling to manage many customers/requests quickly
designAndUsability.clarity: Contextual refill labels (on-site vs station, team en route), payment status/warnings, collapsible progress history, and clear empty/error/loading states
designAndUsability.responsiveness: Works across desktop and mobile widths (wrapped nav, flexible layouts)

knownConstraintsAndDeferred.payments: Manual/offline payment recording/confirmation in-console (no online gateway)
knownConstraintsAndDeferred.pagination: Queue/list endpoints currently sized for current volume; very high volumes may require pagination later
knownConstraintsAndDeferred.accessControl: UI hides some nav by role, but all sensitive actions/data are enforced by server-side permissions

summaryForSharing: The admin page is TOGIV Operations, a staff console for Throne of Grace Integrated Ventures. Staff sign in with password + TOTP and land on a live Overview dashboard. The core is a compact, high-throughput Queue for triaging many refill requests quickly (search/filter/sort, one-click or keyboard advance, contextual on-site/station and 'team en route' labels, unpaid indicators). Request Detail lets staff view full context, record/confirm payment (required before refill completion), change status with audit-friendly reasons, and review a collapsible progress timeline and service attempts. Staff can review/decide/reopen Claims, browse Customers and drill into profiles, and (super admins) create/manage Team accounts; Settings shows account, security posture, and pending business configuration. The console updates live without reloads and is aligned to the on-site/station refill model (no cylinder dispatched).
